FamilyGapDropoutMatched.meaning: mean paired AUROC gap, input-side minus residual-adjacent, dropout at every position, at the matched rule, over the 57 cells it covers

FamilyGapDropoutMatchedLow.meaning: lower bound of the 95% bootstrap interval on family_gap_dropout_matched

FamilyGapDropoutMatchedHigh.meaning: upper bound of the 95% bootstrap interval on family_gap_dropout_matched

FamilyGapDropoutAdaptive.meaning: mean paired AUROC gap, input-side minus residual-adjacent, dropout at every position, at the adaptive rule, over the 57 cells it covers

FamilyGapDropoutAdaptiveLow.meaning: lower bound of the 95% bootstrap interval on family_gap_dropout_adaptive

FamilyGapDropoutAdaptiveHigh.meaning: upper bound of the 95% bootstrap interval on family_gap_dropout_adaptive

FamilyGapMatched.meaning: mean paired AUROC gap, input-side minus residual-adjacent, token_mask at every position, at the matched 0.6 rate, over the 57 cells it covers

FamilyGapMatchedLow.meaning: lower bound of the 95% bootstrap interval on family_gap_matched

FamilyGapMatchedHigh.meaning: upper bound of the 95% bootstrap interval on family_gap_matched

FamilyGapAdaptive.meaning: mean paired AUROC gap, input-side minus residual-adjacent, token_mask at every position, at the adaptive 0.8 rate, over the 57 cells it covers

FamilyGapAdaptiveLow.meaning: lower bound of the 95% bootstrap interval on family_gap_adaptive

FamilyGapAdaptiveHigh.meaning: upper bound of the 95% bootstrap interval on family_gap_adaptive

FamilyGapConfoundedMatched.meaning: mean paired AUROC gap under the basis file's operator-mixing family tags, at the matched 0.6 rate, over the 57 cells it covers

FamilyGapConfoundedMatchedLow.meaning: lower bound of the 95% bootstrap interval on family_gap_confounded_matched

FamilyGapConfoundedMatchedHigh.meaning: upper bound of the 95% bootstrap interval on family_gap_confounded_matched

FamilyGapLocal.meaning: mean paired token_mask family gap at the matched 0.6 rate, local-trigger cells only, over the 15 cells it covers

FamilyGapLocalLow.meaning: lower bound of the 95% bootstrap interval on family_gap_local

FamilyGapLocalHigh.meaning: upper bound of the 95% bootstrap interval on family_gap_local

FamilyGapGlobal.meaning: mean paired token_mask family gap at the matched 0.6 rate, global-trigger cells only, over the 42 cells it covers

FamilyGapGlobalLow.meaning: lower bound of the 95% bootstrap interval on family_gap_global

FamilyGapGlobalHigh.meaning: upper bound of the 95% bootstrap interval on family_gap_global

FamilyGapMinLeaveOneAttackOut.meaning: smallest mean matched-06 token_mask family gap over the leave-one-attack-out refits, the weakest the gap gets when any single attack is removed
